fire: After the siege, Nebuchadnezzar carried the nobles of Judah away to Babylon.

Isaiah foretold that the idols of Babylon would fall and be broken.
In the book of Daniel, the king of Babylon dreams of a great statue.
Ezekiel prophesied among the captives by the river Chebar.
The men of Nineveh repented at the preaching of Jonah in sackcloth.
Zedekiah rebelled, and the Chaldeans burned the house of the Lord.
Hezekiah prayed when the Assyrian king Sennacherib surrounded Jerusalem.
quiet: After the siege, Saladin sent the nobles of Acre away to Damascus.
